arxiv-2105-14238.title: Green’s functions of and emission into discrete anisotropic and hyperbolic baths
arxiv-2105-14238.creator: Lewis Ruks, Thomas Busch
arxiv-2105-14238.description: Abstract In this work, we study wave propagation in generic Hermitian local periodic baths, and investigate the effects of anisotropy and quasi-breaking of periodicity on resonant emission into the band of the bath. We asymptotically decompose the Green’s function into long-range travelling waves composed of all wavevectors (near-)resonant at the emitter frequency, and rapidly decaying evanescent waves.

arxiv-2108-01101.title: Observable flavor violation from spontaneous lepton number breaking
arxiv-2108-01101.description: Abstract We propose a simple model of spontaneous lepton number violation with potentially large flavor violating decays, including the possibility that majoron emitting decays, such as μ → e ​ J \mu\to e\,J , saturate the experimental bounds. In this model the majoron is a singlet-doublet admixture.

arxiv-2108-02409.title: Voltage Stability Studies for Distribution Networks: Assessing Load Dynamics
arxiv-2108-02409.creator: Ruth Kravis, Ian Petersen, Elizabeth Ratnam
arxiv-2108-02409.description: Abstract This paper presents an investigation into load dynamics that potentially cause voltage instability or collapse in distribution networks. Through phasor-based, time domain simulations of a dynamic load (DL) model from the literature, we show that the load dynamics alone do not cause voltage instability or collapse.

arxiv-2204-06486.title: Bounding the difference between model predictive control and neural networks
arxiv-2204-06486.creator: Ross Drummond, Stephen R. Duncan, Matthew C. Turner, Patricia Pauli, Frank Allgöwer
arxiv-2204-06486.description: Abstract There is a growing debate on whether the future of feedback control systems will be dominated by data-driven or model-driven approaches. Each of these two approaches has their own complimentary set of advantages and disadvantages, however, only limited attempts have, so far, been developed to bridge the gap between them.

arxiv-2210-08281.title: Man-in-the-OBD: A modular, protocol agnostic firewall for automotive dongles to enhance privacy and security Thanks: The authors acknowledge the financial support by the Federal Ministry of Education and Research of Germany in the program of ”Souverän. Digital. Vernetzt.” Joint project 6G-RIC, proje
arxiv-2210-08281.creator: Felix Klement, Henrich C. Pöhls, Stefan Katzenbeisser
arxiv-2210-08281.description: Abstract Third-party dongles for cars, e.g. from insurance companies, can extract sensitive data and even send commands to the car via the standardized OBD-II interface. Due to the lack of message authentication mechanisms, this leads to major security vulnerabilities for example regarding the connection with malicious devices.

arxiv-2303-01474.title: Sensitivity analysis of the maximal value function with applications in nonconvex minimax programs
arxiv-2303-01474.creator: Lei Guo, Jane J. Ye, Jin Zhang
arxiv-2303-01474.description: Abstract In this paper, we perform sensitivity analysis for the maximal value function which is the optimal value function for a parametric maximization problem. Our aim is to study various subdifferentials for the maximal value function. We obtain upper estimates of Fréchet, limiting, and horizon subdifferentials of the maximal value function by using some sensitivity analysis techniques sophisticatedly.

arxiv-2303-08068.title: Style Feature Extraction Using Contrastive Conditioned Variational Autoencoders with Mutual Information Constraints
arxiv-2303-08068.creator: Suguru Yasutomi, Toshihisa Tanaka
arxiv-2303-08068.description: Abstract Extracting fine-grained features such as styles from unlabeled data is crucial for data analysis. Unsupervised methods such as variational autoencoders (VAEs) can extract styles that are usually mixed with other features. Conditional VAEs (CVAEs) can isolate styles using class labels; however, there are no established methods to extract only styles using unlabeled data.

arxiv-2304-03321.title: Adaptive Decision-Making with Constraints and Dependent Losses: Performance Guarantees and Applications to Online and Nonlinear Identification The author thanks Fang Nan for fruitful discussions that led to parts of this work. He also thanks the German Research Foundation and the Branco Weiss Fellow
arxiv-2304-03321.creator: Michael Muehlebach
arxiv-2304-03321.description: Abstract We consider adaptive decision-making problems where an agent optimizes a cumulative performance objective by repeatedly choosing among a finite set of options. Compared to the classical prediction-with-expert-advice set-up, we consider situations where losses are constrained and derive algorithms that exploit the additional structure in optimal and computationally efficient ways.

arxiv-2410-00360.title: TFCT-I2P: Three stream fusion network with color aware transformer for image-to-point cloud registration
arxiv-2410-00360.creator: Muyao Peng, Pei An, Zichen Wan, You Yang, Qiong Liu
arxiv-2410-00360.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Muyao Peng, Pei An, Zichen Wan, You Yang, Qiong Liu. Along with the advancements in artificial intelligence technologies, image-to-point-cloud registration (I2P) techniques have made significant strides. Nevertheless, the dimensional differences in the features of points cloud (three-dimension) and image (two-dimension) continue to pose considerable challenges to their development. The primary challenge resides in the inability to leverage the features of one modality to augment those of another, thereby complicating the alignment of features within the latent space.

arxiv-2501-01823.title: Projected ensemble in a system with conserved charges with local support
arxiv-2501-01823.creator: Sandipan Manna, Sthitadhi Roy, G. J. Sreejith
arxiv-2501-01823.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sandipan Manna, Sthitadhi Roy, G. J. Sreejith. The investigation of ergodicity or lack thereof in isolated quantum many-body systems has conventionally focused on the description of the reduced density matrices of local subsystems in the contexts of thermalization, integrability, and localization.

arxiv-2505-19004.title: Secure IVSHMEM: End-to-End Shared-Memory Protocol with Hypervisor-CA Handshake and In-Kernel Access Control
arxiv-2505-19004.creator: Hyunwoo Kim, Jaeseong Lee, Sunpyo Hong, Changmin Han
arxiv-2505-19004.description: Abstract In-host shared memory (IVSHMEM) enables high-throughput, zero-copy communication between virtual machines, but today’s implementations lack any security control, allowing any application to eavesdrop or tamper with the IVSHMEM region. This paper presents Secure IVSHMEM , a protocol that provides end-to-end mutual authentication and fine-grained access enforcement with negligible performance cost.

arxiv-2508-07828.title: The Blooming Tree Algorithm at Work: Clusters, Filaments and Superclusters in the Field of A2029 Facilities: SDSS, Guoshoujing Telescope (LAMOST) astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ) , scipy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , scikit-learn ( Pedregosa et al. 2011 )
arxiv-2508-07828.creator: Heng Yu, Antonaldo Diaferio
arxiv-2508-07828.description: Abstract The Blooming Tree (BT) algorithm, based on the hierarchical clustering method, is designed to identify clusters, groups, and substructures from galaxy redshift surveys. We apply the BT algorithm to a wide-field ( 10 × 10 10\times 10 deg 2 ) spectroscopic dataset centered on the galaxy cluster A2029.

arxiv-2601-11537.title: Building AI-based advisory services for smallholder farmers: Technical learnings from the AIEP Initiative
arxiv-2601-11537.creator: AIEP Initiative, Stewart Collis, Florence Kinyua, Vikram Kumar, Howard Lakougna, Christian Merz, Kirti Pandey, Christian Resch
arxiv-2601-11537.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by AIEP Initiative, Stewart Collis, Florence Kinyua, Vikram Kumar, Howard Lakougna, Christian Merz, Kirti Pandey, Christian Resch. We report technical learnings from five AI-based agricultural advisory MVPs deployed in Kenya and Bihar, India, under the AIEP Initiative. A 800-farmer study found high user satisfaction (NPS ∼ \sim 60).

pmc-10612177.title: HOMA-IR is positively correlated with biological age and advanced aging in the US adult population
pmc-10612177.creator: Haifang Yang, Rongpeng Gong, Moli Liu, Ying Deng, Xiaoyu Zheng, Tianyang Hu
pmc-10612177.description: BackgroundInsulin resistance (IR) had been reported to be associated with age; however, few studies have explored the association between IR and biological age (BA). The HOMA-IR value is a useful indicator of the extent of IR. This cross-sectional study is to explore the relationship between HOMA-IR and BA/advanced aging in the US population.

pmc-11333501.title: A roadmap to the molecular human linking multiomics with population traits and diabetes subtypes
pmc-11333501.creator: Anna Halama, Shaza Zaghlool, Gaurav Thareja, Sara Kader, Wadha Al Muftah, Marjonneke Mook-Kanamori, Hina Sarwath, Yasmin Ali Mohamoud, Nisha Stephan, Sabine Ameling, Maja Pucic Baković, Jan Krumsiek, Cornelia Prehn, Jerzy Adamski, Jochen M. Schwenk, Nele Friedrich, Uwe Völker, Manfred Wuhrer, Gordan
pmc-11333501.description: In-depth multiomic phenotyping provides molecular insights into complex physiological processes and their pathologies. Here, we report on integrating 18 diverse deep molecular phenotyping (omics-) technologies applied to urine, blood, and saliva samples from 391 participants of the multiethnic diabetes Qatar Metabolomics Study of Diabetes (QMDiab).

pmc-11406849.title: LINC01133 promotes the osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells by upregulating CTNNB1 by acting as a sponge for miR-214-3p
pmc-11406849.creator: Chao Tang, Lina Huang, Xiu-Quan Guo, Gang-Gang Wang, Zhigang Chen
pmc-11406849.description: BackgroundOsteoporosis results from decreased bone mass and disturbed bone structure. Human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (hBMSCs) demonstrate robust osteogenic differentiation, a critical process for bone formation. This research was designed to examine the functions of LINC01133 in osteogenic differentiation.MethodsDifferentially expressed lncRNAs affecting osteogenic differentiation in hBMSCs were identified from the GEO database.

pmc-11495373.title: Investigations into the occurrence of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in surface waters of the Narok and Bomet counties of Kenya
pmc-11495373.creator: Bakari Chaka, Aloys M Osano, Omwoyo Wesley Nyaigoti, Patricia B C Forbes
pmc-11495373.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) are a group of emerging chemical pollutants that pose severe health challenges and toxicity to people and aquatic organisms exposed to these pollutants. This study sought to assess the types and levels of PAHs and their eco-toxicity indices in surface waters of Narok and Bomet counties of Kenya, which have witnessed an increase in charcoal-burning activities and vehicular emissions near water bodies.

pmc-11532269.title: Genetic features of avian influenza (A/H5N8) clade 2.3.4.4b isolated from quail in Egypt
pmc-11532269.creator: Mohamed H Elhusseiny, Moataz M Elsayed, Wesam H Mady, Osama Mahana, Neveen R Bakry, Ola Abdelaziz, Abdel-Sattar Arafa, Momtaz A Shahein, Samah Eid, Mahmoud M Naguib
pmc-11532269.description: Highlights•This study reports genetic analyses of the H5N8 virus in quail in Egypt.•The virus is phylogenetically related to other H5N8 viruses within clade 2.3.4.4b.•These findings support the spread of the H5N8 virus to other bird species in Egypt.•Recording mutations indicate their affinity for human-like receptors and increased virulence in mammals.

pmc-12399887.title: Quantification of Differences in Sleep Measurement by a Wrist-Worn Consumer Wearable Compared to Research-Grade Accelerometry and Sleep Diaries of Female Adults in Free-Living Conditions
pmc-12399887.creator: Cindy R Hu, Caitlin Delaney, Jorge E Chavarro, Francine Laden, Rachel Librett, Laura Katuska, Emily R Kaplan, Li Yi, Michael Rueschman, Joe Kossowsky, Jukka-Pekka Onnela, Brent A Coull, Susan Redline, Peter James, Jaime E Hart
pmc-12399887.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeThe objective of this study is to compare sleep measurements by a consumer-wearable with research-standard actigraphy coupled with sleep diaries in free-living female adults.MethodsForty-seven females in the Nurses’ Health Study 3 (NHS3) participated in the Sleep and Physical Activity Validation Substudy (SPAVS), where they were asked to concurrently wear a consumer wearable (Fitbit Charge, Models 3 or 5) and a research-grade accelerometer (Actigraph, GT3X+ or Actisleep) on the same wrist and fill out a smartphone-based sleep diary for fourteen consecutive days.

pmc-12594442.title: A Bioscience Educators’ Purpose in a Modern World
pmc-12594442.creator: Connie Pritchard, Sean Hubbert, Emma Yhnell
pmc-12594442.description: Visual Abstract Introduction As educators working across the United Kingdom, at different career stages and within different types of higher education institutions (HEIs), we have been reflecting on our respective teaching roles and what the future may hold for them.

pmc-12980234.title: Sivelestat and Incidence of Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome After Cardiovascular Surgery
pmc-12980234.creator: Tuo Pan, Can Xu, Ya-Peng Wang, Hui-Li Wang, Wen-Xin Su, Hai-Tao Zhang, Er-Jun Zhu, Yong-Tao Li, Zhi-Kang Lv, Tong-Tong Zhu, Zhi-Wei Xu, Yang Gao, Chuan-Zhang Xu, Jian Shi, Wen-Jie Ji, Ze-Hua Duan, Cheng Zhang, Zhen-Jun Xu, Kun-Sheng Li, Hoshun Chong, Xi-Yu Zhu, Yun-Xing Xue, Wan-Zi Xu, Cheng Chen, W
pmc-12980234.description: Key PointsQuestionDoes postoperative administration of the neutrophil elastase inhibitor sivelestat reduce the incidence of acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) among patients undergoing cardiovascular surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass?FindingsIn this randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial of 424 patients, sivelestat significantly reduced the incidence of postoperative ARDS (16.8% vs 31.2%) and 90-day all-cause mortality (1.1% vs 5.2%) compared with placebo.

pmc-13008863.title: Integrated metabolome and transcriptome profiling demonstrates dynamic regulatory roles of hormones in direct-seeding rice
pmc-13008863.creator: Hang Yang, Zejun Hu, Yong Chen, Xiao Gu, Junhua Ye, Lixia Zhang, Kai Wang, Jianjiang Bai, Liming Cao, Zhenying Shi, Shujun Wu, Ying Yan
pmc-13008863.description: IntroductionDirect-seeding rice faces the prominent challenge of low seedling emergence vigor, particularly under deep-sowing mechanical resistance and hypoxic conditions. Although some physiological traits are known, the systemic molecular networks determining superior emergence remain elusive. MethodsHere, we integrated metabolomic and transcriptomic analyses to compare the elite direct-seeding variety ChongShang2022 (CS2022) with the control Huxiangruan450 (HXR450).

pmc-13306507.title: An Oil Slick Detection Method Based on Advanced Spectral DNA Encoding Strategy by Chinese Zhuhai-1 Satellite Imagery
pmc-13306507.creator: Dong Zhao, Lihui Bi, Jianqiao Feng, Guoxiang Gao, Chuang Qu

pmc-13413034.title: Langer’s Axillary Arch: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Its Prevalence and Clinical Relevance
pmc-13413034.creator: Cosmin Burta, Razvan Danau, Andrei Korodi, Flaviu Ionut Faur, Aida Iancu, Ciprian Duta, Ioana Adelina Faur, Paul Pasca, Catalin Prodan Barbulescu, Vlad Braicu, Amadeus Dobrescu
pmc-13413034.description: Langer’s axillary arch, also known as the axillopectoral muscle, represents a relatively uncommon anatomical variation of the axillary region. Although often asymptomatic, its presence may have important implications in surgical procedures involving the axilla, particularly during breast surgery, axillary lymph node dissection, and reconstructive procedures.

pmc-13442515.title: Development of a pelvic musculoskeletal model based on statistical shape modelling for estimating sacroiliac and pubic joint reaction forces in females
pmc-13442515.creator: Jie Chen, Patria A Hume, Hannah E Wyatt, Julie Choisne
pmc-13442515.description: The sacroiliac joints (SIJs) and pubic symphysis (PS) form a ‘pelvic ring’ that plays a critical role in load transfer between the spine and lower extremities. Direct in vivo measurement of pelvic joint loading remains challenging, and existing musculoskeletal models often simplify or exclude pubic joint contributions.

pmc-13556751.title: 448. Research status and prospect of studies on military sleep support in military operational environments
pmc-13556751.creator: G Xuan
pmc-13556751.description: BackgroundSleep is a basic need for humans to maintain normal life activities. High-quality sleep is not only a guarantee for physical and mental health but also plays an important role in the restoration of the body's immune function. As a special group, military personnel need to be prepared for higher - intensity physical and mental confrontation.

pmc-13662946.title: Ileal amino acid digestibility, and the endogenous enzyme activities in cannulated early growing pig fed soybean meal diets supplemented with β-mannanase
pmc-13662946.creator: So Dam Choi, Habeeb Tajudeen, Jun Young Mun, Abdolreza Hosseindoust, Priscilla Neves Silvestre, Sang Sik Lee, Jin-woo Jhoo, Min Ju Kim, Young In Kim, Jin Soo Kim
pmc-13662946.description: ObjectiveThis study evaluated the effects of dietary β-mannanase supplementation on apparent and standardized ileal amino acid digestibility, endogenous digestive enzyme activity, and digesta viscosity in early growing pigs.MethodsFive 49-day-old Landrace×Yorkshire×Duroc intact male pigs (20.25±0.33 kg body weight) were surgically fitted with distal ileum T-cannula.
